1.web: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger;
1.asv: My son, if thou art become surety for thy neighbor, If thou hast stricken thy hands for a stranger;

2.web: You are trapped by the words of your mouth. You are ensnared with the words of your mouth.
2.asv: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, Thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.

3.web: Do this now, my son, and deliver yourself, since you have come into the hand of your neighbor. Go, humble yourself. Press your plea with your neighbor.
3.asv: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, Seeing thou art come into the hand of thy neighbor: Go, humble thyself, and importune thy neighbor;

4.web: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.
4.asv: Give not sleep to thine eyes, Nor slumber to thine eyelids;

5.web: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.
5.asv: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter, And as a bird from the hand of the fowler.

6.web: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;
6.asv: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; Consider her ways, and be wise:

7.web: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,
7.asv: Which having no chief, Overseer, or ruler,

8.web: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.
8.asv: Provideth her bread in the summer, And gathereth her food in the harvest.

9.web: How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?
9.asv: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? When wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?

10.web: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
10.asv: Yeta little sleep, a little slumber, A little folding of the hands to sleep:

11.web: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.
11.asv: So shall thy poverty come as a robber, And thy want as an armed man.

12.web: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth;
12.asv: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, Is he that walketh with a perverse mouth;

13.web: who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers;
13.asv: That winketh with his eyes, that speaketh with his feet, That maketh signs with his fingers;

14.web: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.
14.asv: In whose heart is perverseness, Who deviseth evil continually, Who soweth discord.

15.web: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.
15.asv: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; On a sudden shall he be broken, and that without remedy.

16.web: There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:
16.asv: There are six things which Jehovah hateth; Yea, seven which are an abomination unto him:

17.web: haughty eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood;
17.asv: Haughty eyes, a lying tongue, And hands that shed innocent blood;

18.web: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,
18.asv: A heart that deviseth wicked purposes, Feet that are swift in running to mischief,

19.web: a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.
19.asv: A false witness that uttereth lies, And he that soweth discord among brethren.

20.web: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.
20.asv: My son, keep the commandment of thy father, And forsake not the law of thy mother:

21.web: Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.
21.asv: Bind them continually upon thy heart; Tie them about thy neck.

22.web: When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.
22.asv: When thou walkest, it shall lead thee; When thou sleepest, it shall watch over thee; And when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.

23.web: For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,
23.asv: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; And reproofs of instruction are the way of life:

24.web: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.
24.asv: To keep thee from the evil woman, From the flattery of the foreigner’s tongue.

25.web: Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.
25.asv: Lust not after her beauty in thy heart; Neither let her take thee with her eyelids.

26.web: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.
26.asv: For on account of a harlota man is broughtto a piece of bread; And the adulteress hunteth for the precious life.

27.web: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?
27.asv: Can a man take fire in his bosom, And his clothes not be burned?

28.web: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?
28.asv: Or can one walk upon hot coals, And his feet not be scorched?

29.web: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.
29.asv: So he that goeth in to his neighbor’s wife; Whosoever toucheth her shall not be unpunished.

30.web: Men don’t despise a thief, if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry:
30.asv: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal To satisfy himself when he is hungry:

31.web: but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.
31.asv: But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; He shall give all the substance of his house.

32.web: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.
32.asv: He that committeth adultery with a woman is void of understanding: He doeth it who would destroy his own soul.

33.web: He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.
33.asv: Wounds and dishonor shall he get; And his reproach shall not be wiped away.

34.web: For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.
34.asv: For jealousy is the rage of a man; And he will not spare in the day of vengeance.

35.web: He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.
35.asv: He will not regard any ransom; Neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.
